contracts.storageOrder: Dense component slots1..count-1. Smaller Actor/T pool; tie Actor. Removal swaps last into hole.
contracts.creation: Append with unchanged pool version; active iterator count is snapshotted; next group query sees new slot.
contracts.pendingRemove: Component bit cleared immediately, buffer still physical, version unchanged.
contracts.pendingDestroy: Typed NextUnsafe does not test entity pending-destroy bit; generation/masks still govern. CommitDestroys clears masks and compacts pools. Component-remove signal side effects must be processed by host.
contracts.committedRemoval: Chosen pool version changes; ValidateIterator throws at next NextBlock including exhaustion, not necessarily before next entity inside already acquired block.
contracts.recycling: CommitDestroys writes freed index to frame free-list head0x28 at0x1819795b8. Create pops free head at0x1819790cc, increments generation and appends components. Helper requires actual refs instead of guessing allocation.
contracts.culling: isView query tests FrameBase.IsCulled0x181977980; non-view query does not.
